item.title: About
item.description:
Meet Janet

I have been obsessed with dogs since I was a kid. For nearly two decades I have built my life and career around taking care of them and learning about them, an endeavor I never intend to quit.

My journey started in 2007 at a dog daycare, where I spent years immersed in caring for a pack of dogs, many of whom I watched grow up. I managed their play, loved on them, did basic training, and learned firsthand that every dog is a true individual with their own personality. It was there that I discovered my passion for understanding dog behavior and began apprenticing under an experienced groomer.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Get in Touch

Ready to book, or just have questions? I’d love to hear from you.

Email: adaptdotdog@gmail.com

I’ll get back to you to talk through your dog’s needs, answer any questions, and find a time that works.

Service Area

Graham, WA and surrounding areas.

What to Expect

When you reach out, it helps to have a few things ready:

  • Your dog’s breed, age, and approximate weight
  • Their coat condition and when they were last groomed
  • Any behavioral notes: nervous, reactive, sensitive areas, etc.
  • Your general availability

The more I know upfront, the better I can prepare to give your dog exactly what they need.

item.title: Services
item.description:
House Call Grooming

A.D.A.P.T. comes to you. Every appointment is one-on-one; just your dog, in their own space, with a groomer who takes the time to do it right.

No crates. No cages. No other animals. No chaos. Just calm, attentive care from start to finish.

What’s Included

Every appointment is all-inclusive:

  • Bath and blow dry
  • Breed-appropriate haircut or trim
  • Nail trim
  • Ear cleaning
  • Paw pad care

Service Area

Graham, WA and surrounding areas.
